<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/plugins/{id}/settings/admin"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Writes the given keys. Every value is validated against the field the manifest declares, and a key the manifest never declared is rejected rather than stored. Validation failures come back per field so a form can show every problem at once. Sending a secret field back as \{ set: true \} leaves the stored value alone, so saving a form does not clear a key it was never shown.
